title: Nutty & Toasted
summary: Toast nuts, seeds, and grains — brown butter and sesame oil are instant nutty depth.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — nutty & toasted is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: toast, fat, salt. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Use tahini or peanut butter in sauces
Acid and fresh crunch (herbs, cucumber) keep nutty richness lively.
